transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Hello Chintu, how are you?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm good doctor, what about you?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: నీకేం ప్రాబ్లం ఉంది? నా.. Hello. What, what problem did you have?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm having disc problem.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, from when did you feeling pain on your disc?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: From past 3 months.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, did you go to gym?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yes doctor, I'll go to gym. From 4 months ago I have started going for gym.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay. Did you started eating non-veg much? Much?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yeah doctor, I'm started eating much non-veg.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, let me check your temperature.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: There is no signs of getting severe pain. You need to rest, rest for a while, don't go to gym, try to sleep early, don't sit on the floor, try to sit on beds, usually don't lift weights, okay?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Yeah, okay doctor. Thank you.

summary.consultation_overview: Patient Chintu presented with disc pain for 3 months. Patient reported going to the gym for the last 4 months and increasing non-vegetarian food consumption. The doctor examined the patient's temperature and provided conservative lifestyle and posture advice.
summary.history_of_present_illness: Patient has been experiencing disc pain for the past 3 months. He started attending the gym 4 months ago and recently increased his non-vegetarian diet.
summary.assessment: Disc pain associated with physical activity/weight lifting.
summary.treatment_plan: Rest and avoid gym, heavy weight lifting, and sitting on the floor.
advice: Do not sit on the floor
